headline: GE Vernova (GEV) Signs Up 43 India Wind Turbines Under Make In India
summary: GE Vernova (NYSE:GEV) agreed to supply 43 onshore wind turbines for Enfinity Global’s Fatehgarh Wind Farm project in India. The turbines are planned to be manufactured under GE Vernova’s Make in India approach, using its established facilities in the country. The order highlights GE Vernova’s role in large scale renewable projects in one of the world’s major wind power markets. headline: AI Electricity Demand: GE Vernova and Eaton Will Capture This Next Wave of Capex
summary: GE Vernova and Eaton both reported blowout quarters fueled by AI power demand, but one company is collecting cash right now while the other is betting on a revenue wave that mostly arrives after 2028. Choosing between them means deciding how much patience you actually have.
